From: Nina Shah <nina.shah@mednyx.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: MedNyx: MAP & deployment preferences

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for yesterday's call. We're ready to move the MAP forward and need a clear recommendation on deployment mode and region to include in the board package. High-level constraints: EU data residency (primary), SOC2 evidence required, and a preferred go-live window by end of Q2 (we have a pilot in mid-May).

Questions we need answered this week:
- Which mode (hosted / dedicated / private) best balances compliance & time-to-prod for an initial pilot?
- Rough timeline to get an EU-dedicated deployment vs hosted option (including any regional availability windows).
- Any gating items (security evidence, network peering, certs) that typically push us > 6 weeks?

I've attached our latest ALS (acceptance & success) draft and the security questionnaire. Can you also include a short MAP draft with milestones so we can show the execs how we move to GA?

Appreciate it — Nina

Attachments: MedNyx_security_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx), ALS_draft_v3.docx (docx)
From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
To: Nina Shah <nina.shah@mednyx.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MedNyx: MAP & deployment preferences

Nina — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary up front: for a pilot with EU residency and SOC2 needs, our recommended path is a staged approach: dedicated EU capacity for pilot (fastest compliant route with predictable performance) with hosted fallback for burst or non-sensitive workloads. Private on-prem would be our gate-to-GA option if you need full air-gap / on-prem controls later.

I attached a one-page MAP draft (MedNyx_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a milestone ladder below. Key rough estimates:
- Dedicated EU provision: 3–5 weeks to reserve and configure (depends on billing PO + network peering).
- Hosted EU: immediate (hours) for evaluation, but doesn't satisfy strict contractually-scoped data residency unless we sign a dedicated tenancy clause.
- Private/on-prem: 8–12+ weeks (hardware + network + compliance asserts).

Milestones (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): Finalize MAP and sign MSA addendum for EU dedicated tenancy (owner: MedNyx legal)
2) Week 1–3: Dedicated pool reservation + network peering + SOC2 artifact exchange (owner: Redwood infra, MedNyx security)
3) Week 3–5: Pilot run (performance + acceptance tests) + payor billing test (owner: MedNyx product)
4) Week 6–8: Roll to canary GA or opt for private if required (owner: jointly)

Immediate asks from our side: signed PO or commitment to reserved capacity (email okay), contact for network peering (IP ranges + AC contact), and a prioritized list of the top 10 API flows you'll validate in pilot.

I'll loop in priyom and laura who can own the MAP delivery cadence and acceptance criteria.

Alex Martinez
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: MedNyx_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:26:00 -0500
Subject: FW: MedNyx: MAP & deployment preferences

Alex / team — forwarding Nina's note and my quick ops checklist below. I suggest we propose two parallel lanes in the MAP to avoid blocking the exec ask:

Lane A (priority): EU Dedicated pilot
- Reserve 2x V100-equivalent slots w/ burst pool (owner: Redwood infra)
- Prep SOC2 artifact list and sample logs (owner: k.iyer)
- Peering: ask MedNyx for preferred subnets + hop count test window
- Acceptance test: 95th pct latency < 220ms on 8k token workload

Lane B (parallel, low friction): Hosted eval in EU region
- Create hosted API key + sample dataset masking (owner: laura)
- Run 1-week smoke tests against core flows

Risks: procurement lead times and certificate provisioning. If MedNyx can commit to PO this week we can hit the 3–5 week timeline for dedicated.

I'll create a shared tracker in Drive and add the initial gating list.

-- Priyom

Subject: Re: MedNyx: MAP & deployment preferences — security follow-up

Hi Alex / team —

Thanks for the plan. We ran the questionnaire through our security committee and have two items that determine whether we stay dedicated vs push to private for GA:
1) KMS/HSM integration for key custody (we need either tenant-isolated KMS or proof of HSM-backed keys).
2) Audit log retention & export: 2 years of immutable logs required for select admin events.

If Redwood can provide tenant-isolated KMS and a signed retention SLA, we'll be comfortable with dedicated for pilot and can revisit private later. Otherwise we will likely require an on-prem deployment for GA.

We can share the SOC2 evidence package (attached) and would like to schedule a short technical call next week to review peering and KMS options.

Regards,
Nina (on behalf of MedNyx security)

Nina / team —

Appreciate the quick review. Proposal update and agreed next steps:

Decision (recommended): Start with EU Dedicated for the pilot with the following hard constraints to be confirmed by Friday:
- Tenant-isolated KMS or HSM-backed key promise (we can scope a KMS integration addendum in the MSA).
- Audit log retention SLA (we will provide exportable, immutable admin logs with 24/7 access; SLA text draft attached).

If both items are accepted, timeline to dedicated pilot start: 3 weeks from signed PO + network peering details (exact cutover depends on customer firewall window). If either item cannot be agreed, fallback is: hosted EU for evaluation and expedited private-on-prem conversation to plan GA.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- MedNyx legal: sign EU tenancy addendum / send PO (due: Fri, 12 Mar 2027)
- MedNyx infra: share peering contact + allowed subnets (due: Tue, 9 Mar 2027)
- Redwood infra (karthik): prepare tenant KMS options + draft addendum (due: Thu, 11 Mar 2027)
- Redwood delivery (priyom): set up dedicated pool reservation and readiness checklist (kickoff when PO received)
- Redwood biz (laura): enable hosted eval keys and masked sample dataset (available immediately)

I'll attach the MAP v2 workbook and a short acceptance-ladder sheet for the exec packet. Let's plan a 30-minute technical sync Wed 10 Mar 2027 14:00 CET / 09:00 UK time — I will send the invite once we confirm attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.
